t: The Steam Generator is a creative-only part that acts as a constant source of steam for a Turbine.$(br2)This part automatically supplies steam up to the maximum amount allowed by the part variant to the Vapor Fluid Tank, but only when the Turbine is active.
蒸汽发电机是一个仅限创造模式使用的部件，它会为涡轮机持续提供蒸汽。$(br2)该部件会自动向蒸汽流体储罐补充蒸汽，数量上限取决于该部件变种所允许的最大值，但只有在涡轮机处于运行状态时才会生效。
